messages:
maya_cs: Heads up — Bankroll onboarding: token burn spiked ~4x in last 48h. Sharing a quick forecast and asks.
leo_finops: Saw that, thanks. Baseline forecast looks like ~$2.1k this month if current trend holds. Did they enable the full embed pipeline?
maya_cs: Yes, they flipped to embed-heavy flow yesterday. Onboarding status: prod keys issued, integrations live, but many short queries -> high per-token cost.
toni_se: Do we have avg sequence lengths and repetition stats? If short with repeated prefixes, batching + prefix KV cache can help a lot.
maya_cs: Avg input ~120 tokens, lots of repeated boilerplate. Uploaded sample prompt set: https://redwood.internal/samples/bankroll-embed.txt
leo_finops: Quick back-of-envelope: enabling batching + cache could cut token burn by ~45%. That would bring est monthly spend to ~ $1.2k (vs $2.1k). Need engineering estimate for rollout effort.
sam_sales: Heads-up — renewal meeting scheduled next Tue. If we can present a concrete cost-reduction plan + timeline, it materially lowers renewal friction.
maya_cs: Proposed 2-step enablement: 1) deploy batching & prefix cache (ETA 48h), 2) set conservative quota alerts + soft caps for first 2 weeks. Also request a short enablement doc for the account.
toni_se: I'll open a PR for batching config today. Quick snippet for review: 
```yaml
batching:
  window_ms: 80
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
cache:
  prefix_enabled: true
  ttl_hours: 6
```
deploy-bot: deploy started for team/bankroll/batching-config — build #4521
leo_finops: I'll draft a one-pager for the QBR: before/after spend, estimated runway delta, units saved, and clear action items. Will include sensitivity (10/25/50% traffic growth).
maya_cs: Action items summary: toni_se -> PR + prod rollout; leo_finops -> QBR one-pager + sensitivity table; sam_sales -> add cost mitigation bullet to renewal deck and pull any downstream objections. I'll log this in the CS record and ping again 24h post-rollout for metrics.
sam_sales: Added to renewal deck and flagged follow-up Qs. If they ask for a guaranteed cap, can we propose a short trial quota with auto-escalation?
maya_cs: Good idea — propose soft quota with auto-notify then manual uplift. Thanks all :thumbsup: Will follow up in 24h with prod metrics.
